summary: Randolph Public Schools heavily relies on E-Rate for broadband to support modern learning. Losing funding would have significant negative impacts on the community, including increased class sizes and challenges in accessing modern curriculum. The school district emphasizes the importance of preserving E-Rate funding to maintain essential services and educational resources.

claims.argument: Budget dollars are always highly sought after, with the amount of funding that we are able to get through E-Rate being equivalent to close to 3 teachers or 4 Paraprofessionals.
claims.evidence_quote: This community would suffer a great loss without this funding.  Budget dollars are always highly sought after, with the amount of funding that we are able to get through E-Rate being equivalent to close to 3 teachers or 4 Paraprofessionals.
